params.name: interval
params.description: Specifies the range of dueDates to be queried. Milliseconds will be truncated. A maximum of 1 year can be specified in the range. End date is not inclusive. Intervals are represented as an ISO-8601 string. For example: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss/YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss

params.name: completionInterval
params.description: Specifies the range of completion dates to be used for filtering. A maximum of 1 year can be specified in the range. End date is not inclusive. Intervals are represented as an ISO-8601 string. For example: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss/YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss

params.name: overdue
params.description: Specifies if only the non-overdue (overdue is "False") or overdue (overdue is "True") assignments are returned. If overdue is "Any" or if the overdue parameter is not supplied, all assignments are returned

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Page size

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: Page number

params.name: pass
params.description: Specifies if only the failed (pass is "False") or passed (pass is "True") assignments (completed with assessment)are returned. If pass is "Any" or if the pass parameter is not supplied, all assignments are returned

params.name: minPercentageScore
params.description: The minimum assessment score for an assignment (completed with assessment) to be included in the results (inclusive)

params.name: maxPercentageScore
params.description: The maximum assessment score for an assignment (completed with assessment) to be included in the results (inclusive)

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Specifies result set sort order; if not specified, default sort order is descending (Desc)

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Specifies which field to sort the results by, default sort is by recommendedCompletionDate

params.name: userId
params.description: Specifies the list of user IDs to be queried, up to 100 user IDs.

params.name: types
params.description: Specifies the module types to filter by. Informational, AssessedContent and Assessment are deprecated

params.name: states
params.description: Specifies the assignment states to filter by

params.description: Specifies the expand option for returning additional information
